text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I head into the cafeteria during the
lunch
break, I spot Inari One with a
veritable mountain
of dishes in front of
her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss, ya gotta hear this! Looks like
the
cafeteria has gone and changed their
fried tofu
supplier.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss, ya gotta hear this! Looks like
the
cafeteria has gone and changed their
fried tofu
supplier.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When I tried the inari sushi, it tasted so
freakin'
good. Left me absolutely
stunned!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So, I ended up orderin' every fried tofu
dish on
the menu! Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oof?! Ya don't pull your punches...
choice_data_list: いくら何でも頼みすぎでは？
choice_data_list_en: Aren't you ordering way too much?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I suppose one look at my plate and
anyone'd say
that, though. But I can't
return the order, so...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now we're talkin'! I can always try
the rest of
the menu some other day. So,
I'll hold back on
gorgin' myself this time.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll kick things off with the kitsune soba!
Haaah!
Look at that fatty tofu soakin' up
all the broth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I help prevent Inari One from
overeating
by sharing in her meal.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! I'm gonna scarf down every last
bite!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Lookit this thick block of fried
perfection! I can
practically taste it
already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Inari One fills her stomach with a
feast of
fried tofu dishes.
